payload.title: Optimize several outputs without serial review latency
payload.description:
Labeling a 5-question checklist shouldn't stall the reviewer while 5 optimizations run one after another.

Current: every output reaches the cadence count on the same review (learning_loop.py:146-153); _learn runs inside review() under the cyclotron lock (embedded_cyclotron.py:729).

Desired: optimization queued after the review; outputs run concurrently or in a scheduled order.

Acceptance: review latency doesn't grow with output count; per-output optimizer runs recorded; optimizer call limit shared and enforced.
